{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F01","text":"本行以“中国最卓越、全球领先的智能化零售银行”为战略目标，坚持“零售做强、对公做精、同业做专”战略方针，持续升级零售、对公、资金同业三大业务经营策略。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0003"]},{"fact_id":"F02","text":"分部经营数据将集团业务划分为零售金融业务、批发金融业务和其他业务三个板块列示营业收入、营业支出、减值损失前营业利润、信用及其他资产减值损失、利润总额和净利润。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F03","text":"零售业务包括个人贷款业务与信用卡业务：个人贷款涵盖住房按揭贷款、信用卡应收账款、消费性贷款和经营性贷款；信用卡业务面向白领、年轻客群、车主及财富客群提供联名卡、白金卡等产品权益。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0007"]},{"fact_id":"F04","text":"对公业务聚焦产业金融、科技金融、供应链金融、跨境金融、普惠金融重点方向，并精选公共事业、数字产业、制造业、医疗、能源、汽车等重点细分行业提供定制化行业服务方案。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0009"]},{"fact_id":"F05","text":"资金同业业务通过“投资交易+客户业务”双轮驱动，投资交易领域采取多元化资产配置策略，客户业务领域为同业和企业客户提供金融服务，并聚焦清算结算型业务场景经营。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0011"]},{"fact_id":"F06","text":"数字金融方面，本行发布平安口袋银行APP 8.0版本，升级“AI+T+Offline”服务模式；对公业务构建AI标书助手并应用OCR、NLP技术；资金同业业务依托“iDeal结构化询报价”和“行e通”平台提升交易与服务效率。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0013"]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F07","text":"2025年本集团实现营业收入1,314.42亿元，同比下降10.4%；其中利息净收入880.21亿元，同比下降5.8%，非利息净收入434.21亿元，同比下降18.5%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0003","source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"1,314.42","value":"1314.42","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"10.4%","value":"10.4","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"同比"},{"name":"利息净收入","raw_value":"880.21","value":"880.21","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"非利息净收入","raw_value":"434.21","value":"434.21","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F08","text":"营业收入构成中，利息净收入88,021百万元、占比67.0%；非利息净收入43,421百万元、占比33.0%，其中手续费及佣金净收入23,894百万元、占比18.2%，其他非利息净收入19,527百万元、占比14.8%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"利息净收入","raw_value":"88,021","value":"88021","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"利息净收入占比","raw_value":"67.0%","value":"67.0","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"非利息净收入","raw_value":"43,421","value":"43421","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"非利息净收入占比","raw_value":"33.0%","value":"33.0","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"手续费及佣金净收入","raw_value":"23,894","value":"23894","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"手续费及佣金净收入占比","raw_value":"18.2%","value":"18.2","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他非利息净收入","raw_value":"19,527","value":"19527","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他非利息净收入占比","raw_value":"14.8%","value":"14.8","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F09","text":"利息收入按项目分为发放贷款和垫款130,501百万元（占比76.8%）、金融投资27,327百万元（占比16.2%）、存放同业、拆放同业及买入返售金融资产8,915百万元（占比5.2%）、存放中央银行款项3,120百万元（占比1.8%），利息收入小计169,863百万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"发放贷款和垫款利息收入","raw_value":"130,501","value":"130501","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"发放贷款和垫款利息收入占比","raw_value":"76.8%","value":"76.8","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"金融投资利息收入","raw_value":"27,327","value":"27327","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"金融投资利息收入占比","raw_value":"16.2%","value":"16.2","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"存放同业、拆放同业及买入返售金融资产利息收入","raw_value":"8,915","value":"8915","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"存放同业、拆放同业及买入返售金融资产利息收入占比","raw_value":"5.2%","value":"5.2","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"存放中央银行款项利息收入","raw_value":"3,120","value":"3120","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"存放中央银行款项利息收入占比","raw_value":"1.8%","value":"1.8","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"利息收入小计","raw_value":"169,863","value":"169863","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F10","text":"利息支出按项目分为吸收存款59,409百万元（占比72.6%）、已发行债务证券12,125百万元（占比14.8%）、同业存放、同业拆入及卖出回购金融资产款8,367百万元（占比10.2%）、向中央银行借款1,941百万元（占比2.4%），利息支出小计81,842百万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"吸收存款利息支出","raw_value":"59,409","value":"59409","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"吸收存款利息支出占比","raw_value":"72.6%","value":"72.6","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"已发行债务证券利息支出","raw_value":"12,125","value":"12125","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"已发行债务证券利息支出占比","raw_value":"14.8%","value":"14.8","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"同业存放、同业拆入及卖出回购金融资产款利息支出","raw_value":"8,367","value":"8367","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"同业存放、同业拆入及卖出回购金融资产款利息支出占比","raw_value":"10.2%","value":"10.2","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"向中央银行借款利息支出","raw_value":"1,941","value":"1941","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"向中央银行借款利息支出占比","raw_value":"2.4%","value":"2.4","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"利息支出小计","raw_value":"81,842","value":"81842","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F11","text":"分部营业收入构成：零售金融业务61,626百万元、占比46.9%；批发金融业务57,959百万元、占比44.1%；其他业务11,857百万元、占比9.0%；合计131,442百万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"零售金融业务营业收入","raw_value":"61,626","value":"61626","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"零售金融业务营业收入占比","raw_value":"46.9%","value":"46.9","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"批发金融业务营业收入","raw_value":"57,959","value":"57959","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"批发金融业务营业收入占比","raw_value":"44.1%","value":"44.1","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业收入","raw_value":"11,857","value":"11857","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业收入占比","raw_value":"9.0%","value":"9.0","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入合计","raw_value":"131,442","value":"131442","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F12","text":"分部净利润构成：零售金融业务2,683百万元、占比6.3%；批发金融业务30,540百万元、占比71.6%；其他业务9,410百万元、占比22.1%；合计42,633百万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"零售金融业务净利润","raw_value":"2,683","value":"2683","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"零售金融业务净利润占比","raw_value":"6.3%","value":"6.3","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"批发金融业务净利润","raw_value":"30,540","value":"30540","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"批发金融业务净利润占比","raw_value":"71.6%","value":"71.6","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务净利润","raw_value":"9,410","value":"9410","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务净利润占比","raw_value":"22.1%","value":"22.1","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"净利润合计","raw_value":"42,633","value":"42633","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F13","text":"2025年末本集团资产总额59,257.77亿元，较上年末增长2.7%；发放贷款和垫款本金总额33,908.40亿元，较上年末增长0.5%；负债总额53,745.93亿元，较上年末增长1.9%；吸收存款本金余额35,827.55亿元，较上年末增长1.4%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"资产总额","raw_value":"59,257.77","value":"59257.77","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"资产总额较上年末增长","raw_value":"2.7%","value":"2.7","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年末"},{"name":"发放贷款和垫款本金总额","raw_value":"33,908.40","value":"33908.40","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"发放贷款和垫款本金总额较上年末增长","raw_value":"0.5%","value":"0.5","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年末"},{"name":"负债总额","raw_value":"53,745.93","value":"53745.93","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"吸收存款本金余额","raw_value":"35,827.55","value":"35827.55","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F14","text":"2025年本行IT资本性支出及费用投入48.06亿元，持续推动资源整合优化，提升研发和管理效能。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0013"],"metrics":[{"name":"IT资本性支出及费用投入","raw_value":"48.06","value":"48.06","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F15","text":"2025年本集团业务及管理费381.96亿元，同比下降5.9%；信用及其他资产减值损失405.67亿元，同比下降17.9%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"业务及管理费","raw_value":"381.96","value":"381.96","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"业务及管理费同比增减","raw_value":"5.9%","value":"5.9","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"同比"},{"name":"信用及其他资产减值损失","raw_value":"405.67","value":"405.67","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"信用及其他资产减值损失同比增减","raw_value":"17.9%","value":"17.9","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"同比"}]},{"fact_id":"F16","text":"2025年本集团计息负债平均付息率1.67%，同比2024年下降47个基点；吸收存款平均付息率1.65%，同比下降42个基点；活期存款日均余额11,919.78亿元，同比增长5.8%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"计息负债平均付息率","raw_value":"1.67%","value":"1.67","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"计息负债平均付息率同比变动","raw_value":"47个基点","value":"47","unit":"基点","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"同比"},{"name":"吸收存款平均付息率","raw_value":"1.65%","value":"1.65","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"活期存款日均余额","raw_value":"11,919.78","value":"11919.78","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"customers_channels_markets":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F17","text":"零售信用卡业务2025年末信用卡流通户数4,369.31万户，全年信用卡总消费金额20,124.35亿元；渠道建设方面强化产品及策略赋能，提升属地获客经营效率。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"信用卡流通户数","raw_value":"4,369.31","value":"4369.31","unit":"万户","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"信用卡总消费金额","raw_value":"20,124.35","value":"20124.35","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F18","text":"对公客户分层经营体系覆盖战略客户、中型客户、小型客户；2025年末对公客户数96.60万户，较上年末增长13.2%；总行级战略客户数3,239户，总行级战略客户贷款余额3,731.29亿元、同口径较上年末增长20.5%，存款余额4,819.73亿元、同口径较上年末增长2.4%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"对公客户数","raw_value":"96.60","value":"96.60","unit":"万户","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"对公客户数较上年末增长","raw_value":"13.2%","value":"13.2","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年末"},{"name":"总行级战略客户数","raw_value":"3,239","value":"3239","unit":"户","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"总行级战略客户贷款余额","raw_value":"3,731.29","value":"3731.29","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"总行级战略客户存款余额","raw_value":"4,819.73","value":"4819.73","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F19","text":"机构客户方面，本行聚焦财政社保、住建民生、司法生态三大核心业务；2025年末已累计获取财政社保、公积金、维修金等业务资格1,232项，全年机构客户存款日均余额4,264.89亿元，同比2024年增长4.7%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"机构业务资格累计获取数","raw_value":"1,232","value":"1232","unit":"项","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"机构客户存款日均余额","raw_value":"4,264.89","value":"4264.89","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"机构客户存款日均余额同比增减","raw_value":"4.7%","value":"4.7","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"同比"}]},{"fact_id":"F20","text":"数字金融方面，2025年末本行为近860万大众客户提供7×24小时的“陪伴式”服务；跨境智能审单识别准确率超93%；“iDeal结构化询报价”现券交易量约3.6万亿元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0013"],"metrics":[{"name":"7×24小时“陪伴式”服务大众客户数","raw_value":"近860万","value":"860","unit":"万户","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"approximate"},{"name":"跨境智能审单识别准确率","raw_value":"超93%","value":"93","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"greater_than"},{"name":"“iDeal结构化询报价”现券交易量","raw_value":"约3.6万亿元","value":"3.6","unit":"万亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"approximate"}]}]},"operating_drivers":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F21","text":"2025年净息差1.78%，同比2024年下降9个基点，主要受贷款利率下行和业务结构调整等因素影响；营业收入下降还主要受市场波动影响，债券投资等业务非利息净收入下降。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","evidence_ids":["source-0003","source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"净息差","raw_value":"1.78%","value":"1.78","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"净息差同比变动","raw_value":"9个基点","value":"9","unit":"基点","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"同比"}]},{"fact_id":"F22","text":"资产结构方面，2025年末企业贷款余额较上年末增长3.5%，其中一般企业贷款余额较 77","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"material_changes":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F24","text":"2025年本行持续优化零售资产组合策略，提升住房按揭等贷款业务占比：住房按揭贷款余额355,148百万元、较上年末增长8.9%，信用卡应收账款余额405,442百万元、下降6.8%，消费性贷款余额463,017百万元、下降2.5%，经营性贷款余额503,687百万元、下降5.2%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"住房按揭贷款余额","raw_value":"355,148","value":"355148","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"住房按揭贷款余额较上年末增长","raw_value":"8.9%","value":"8.9","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年末"},{"name":"信用卡应收账款余额","raw_value":"405,442","value":"405442","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"消费性贷款余额","raw_value":"463,017","value":"463017","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"经营性贷款余额","raw_value":"503,687","value":"503687","unit":"百万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F25","text":"对公业务方面，2025年末企业存款余额22,952.55亿元，较上年末增长2.2%；企业贷款余额16,635.46亿元，较上年末增长3.5%；重点细分行业贷款余额较上年末增加501.46亿元。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"企业存款余额","raw_value":"22,952.55","value":"22952.55","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"企业存款余额较上年末增长","raw_value":"2.2%","value":"2.2","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年末"},{"name":"企业贷款余额","raw_value":"16,635.46","value":"16635.46","unit":"亿元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年末","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"重点细分行业贷
